properties.note: Pre-reaction complex = (2E,4Z,6E)-octa-2,4,6-triene in the reactive s-cis,s-cis (C-shaped) conformation, helically twisted by -32.7 deg about C3-C4 and C5-C6; B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP gas-phase minimum (54 real modes, 0 imaginary). Lowest verified reactant conformer in the evidence: the methyl-rotamer conformer work/rc/rc02_optfreq.log is degenerate within 3e-9 Ha, and the reactant-side IRC frame relaxes onto a flat mirror-symmetric twist/methyl-torsion ridge (-50 cm-1, -311.823946 Ha, +1.1 kcal/mol) that connects the two enantiomeric helical conformers; work/ts/rc_endpoint3_optfreq.log (-311.825755379, 0 imaginary) returns to this same minimum from that ridge.

Disrotatory 6pi ring-closure saddle; first-order (one imaginary mode at -496.58 cm-1, forming-bond pair C2...C7 projected fraction 0.62, opposite-sense terminal twist). C2...C7 = 2.269 A, C2-C3 = C6-C7 = 1.407 A, C3=C4 = C5=C6 = 1.394 A. Barrier dE = +20.43 kcal/mol over RC, +40.3 over P. One imaginary frequency is the required signature for this transition_state role; the species-level 'geometry = local minimum' check does not apply to a TS node (tool limitation, reported as such, not a chemical gap). IRC direction: same-saddle bidirectional IRC (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0005/irc/irc.log) runs forward to the cis product side (work/ts/p_endpoint_optfreq.log) and backward onto a first-order twist/methyl-torsion ridge (work/ts/rc_endpoint_optfreq.log, -50 cm-1, +1.1 kcal/mol), from which the RC minimum is reached by displacement along that mode (work/ts/rc_endpoint3/4_optfreq.log); the reverse IRC itself does not reach RC. The harness IRC stage flag is therefore disclosed as skipped-by-construction, not repaired.
cis-5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene (ring-junction methyls on the same face); 0 imaginary modes. Reference-only trans isomer: work/p/p02_trans_optfreq.log, -311.857630768 Ha.

edges.channel: disrotatory 6pi electrocyclization (single channel computed; Woodward-Hoffmann allowed for a thermal ground-state 6pi system) -> cis ring junction
